title: IRF Constitutional Renewal + Tiny Grant Output Strategy
reason_for_renewal: User supplied strengthened boundary constitution and clarified that first two grants due by date are small-dollar, small-response opportunities requiring lightweight wrappers rather than heavy response packs.

canonical_update.principle: No-HITL means execution continuity without manual dependency inside immutable policy boundaries, not unconstrained authority.

separation.autonomous_execution: Runtime may execute operational tasks continuously within policy envelopes.
separation.autonomous_authority: Runtime may not independently expand authority over communications, identity, claims, finance, destructive operations, governance, credentials, health/legal interpretation, or production mutation.

boundary_domains.rule: AUTONOMOUS_WITH_POLICY_GUARDS is a runtime state, not marketing language.
boundary_domains.enforcement: All workers inherit policy envelopes before execution; no worker executes outside declared scope.

boundary_domains.rule: runtime_hitl:false applies to operational execution, not governance override authority.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Humans define policy/legal/emergency/strategic constraints but are not required for normal runtime continuity.
boundary_domains.failure: PARTIAL if execution pauses awaiting humans.

boundary_domains.rule: Delete, overwrite, revoke, purge, disable, financial mutation, credential mutation, irreversible publication blocked by default.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Explicit policy unlock, evidence receipt, and rollback path required.
boundary_domains.failure: FAIL if destructive actions execute silently.

boundary_domains.rule: bridge_secret_store_only with immutable credential provenance.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Workers cannot create/export/print secrets or inject undeclared credentials.
boundary_domains.failure: CRITICAL if secrets appear in logs, prompts, queues, or artifacts.

boundary_domains.rule: Every worker action carries signed actor lineage.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Queue job -> worker -> bridge -> outbound event preserves immutable execution identity.

boundary_domains.rule: External send paths limited to approved channels, bounded templates, verified domains, and policy-scanned payloads.
boundary_domains.enforcement: SES/mail/SMS/webhook/social publishing must pass policy_guard, evidence_guard, provenance_guard.
boundary_domains.failure: BLOCKED if route or policy proof absent.

boundary_domains.rule: Runtime may not invent claims, statistics, approvals, diagnoses, guarantees, outcomes, affiliations, or timelines.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Externally visible assertions require evidence binding or provenance reference.
boundary_domains.failure: PRETEND if unsupported claims are emitted.

boundary_domains.rule: Child-development, mental-health, educational, behavioural, or neuro-related content defaults to informational only.
boundary_domains.enforcement: No diagnosis, treatment instruction, crisis advice, or therapeutic certainty.

boundary_domains.rule: No eligibility guarantees, legal interpretations, compliance certainty, or funding promises.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Only describe pathways and public guidance with evidence-backed references.

boundary_domains.rule: Revenue, invoices, entitlements, grants, or funding flows require ledger-backed traceability.
boundary_domains.enforcement: No synthetic revenue events or assumed monetisation states.
boundary_domains.failure: PRETEND if economic state lacks receipts.

boundary_domains.rule: REAL requires executable runtime, telemetry continuity, receipts, and recovery proof.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Docs/specs/slides/code alone remain PARTIAL.

boundary_domains.rule: No invisible execution permitted.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Every state transition, failure, retry, outbound action, and recovery event emits telemetry.

boundary_domains.rule: Runtime prohibited from fake-complete, suppress-error, no-op-complete, or hidden retry exhaustion.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Failures surface into queues, dead letters, alerts, and evidence ledgers.

boundary_domains.rule: Deterministic recovery mandatory.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Queue replay, worker resurrection, state reconciliation, idempotent retry paths required.

boundary_domains.rule: Archive-not-delete enforced platform-wide.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Historical queues, evidence, metrics, receipts, outbound logs, and ledger state preserved immutably.
boundary_domains.failure: FAIL if operational history can be erased.

boundary_domains.rule: Workers may not self-modify policy, governance, or execution constraints.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Governance plane isolated from worker execution plane.
boundary_domains.failure: CRITICAL if worker can alter constitutional rules.

boundary_domains.rule: Runtime may only invoke allowlisted tools/routes.
boundary_domains.enforcement: No arbitrary shell, unrestricted HTTP, uncontrolled model chaining, or undeclared connectors.

boundary_domains.rule: LLMs are bounded reasoning engines, not sovereign actors.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Hosted models cannot directly execute infra mutations without bridge mediation.
boundary_domains.failure: PRETEND if model claims direct execution without receipts.

boundary_domains.rule: Queue-first execution mandatory.
boundary_domains.enforcement: No hidden side-channel execution outside canonical work queue and evidence ledger.

boundary_domains.rule: Runtime cannot manipulate, pressure, deceive, impersonate, or socially engineer users.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Persuasive or authority-based coercion prohibited.

boundary_domains.rule: Runtime defaults to minimum necessary access.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Sensitive data segmented by role, policy, and environment.
boundary_domains.failure: FAIL if unrestricted cross-domain access exists.

boundary_domains.rule: Dev -> Pen -> Synapse promotion requires receipts and Gatekeeper policy validation.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Runtime cannot self-promote into production without constitutional checks.

boundary_domains.rule: Runtime must prove unattended continuity.
boundary_domains.enforcement: 72h survivability requires recovery, telemetry continuity, queue drain behaviour, bounded degradation.

boundary_domains.rule: Reality Ledger is canonical truth surface.
boundary_domains.enforcement: State escalates PRETEND -> PARTIAL -> REAL only through evidence transitions.
boundary_domains.failure: FAIL if classifications mutable without evidence.

boundary_domains.rule: Canonical policy bundles versioned and immutable once promoted.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Runtime references signed policy manifests.
boundary_domains.failure: CRITICAL if runtime policy drifts silently.

boundary_domains.rule: External APIs/services are survivability dependencies.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Runtime degrades safely if providers fail.
boundary_domains.failure: PARTIAL if dependency loss causes uncontrolled behaviour.

boundary_domains.rule: Autonomous content publication restricted to bounded domains and verified inventories.
boundary_domains.enforcement: No live-generation publishing without moderation and provenance binding.

boundary_domains.rule: Every runtime capability exposes health, queue depth, retries, cost, latency, evidence state.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Command Centre visibility mandatory.

boundary_domains.rule: Emergency stop and governance freeze only through explicit constitutional authority.
boundary_domains.enforcement: Overrides logged immutably with actor attribution.

grant_output_strategy_update.note: First two grants due by close date are small-dollar and small-response. Do not overbuild. Use tiny wrappers and reuse blocks.
grant_output_strategy_update.tiny_grant_rule: For grants under approximately AUD 10k or short council/community forms, output must be lightweight: 1-page project summary, 1-page budget, 1-page evidence/impact note, attachment checklist only if required.
